The first six terms sum to \(5+16+8+4+2+1=36\).

After \(a_6\), the repeating cycle is \(4,2,1\). There are \(2018-6=2012\) remaining terms. Since
\[
2012 = 3\cdot 670 + 2,
\]
these contribute
\[
670(4+2+1) + (4+2) = 670\cdot 7 + 6 = 4690+6=4696.
\]

Thus,
\[
S_{2018}=36+4696=4732.
\]

\[
\boxed{4732}
\]
